rules.description: No facts with filed_date in the future
rules.rationale: Future filed_dates indicate data corruption or incorrect date parsing — SEC filings are always historical

rules.description: start_date < end_date for all period facts
rules.rationale: A period where start >= end is logically impossible — indicates date parsing or mapping error

rules.description: Superseded facts have filed_date <= superseding fact's filed_date
rules.rationale: Supersession is defined by filing order — if a 'superseded' fact was filed AFTER its superseder, the supersession logic is broken

rules.description: filed_date >= end_date (filings come after period ends)
rules.threshold: 99% — allows edge cases (NT filings, preliminary filings)
rules.rationale: Filings should be submitted after the period they cover. Some edge cases exist (NT filings, pre-release), so 99% threshold avoids false failures while catching systemic issues

rules.description: Every superseded_by accession number exists in facts
rules.rationale: A superseded_by reference to a non-existent accession indicates orphaned supersession — the superseding filing is missing from the dataset
